settings.seo_title: Aarav & Diya's Wedding Invitation | આરવ અને દિયા
settings.seo_description: We cordially invite you to celebrate the wedding of Aarav and Diya. Join us for a beautiful celebration of traditional Gujarati culture and love.

couple.groom_bio: A passionate software engineer who loves trekking, photography, and traditional Gujarati cuisine.
couple.bride_bio: A creative graphic designer who loves classical dance, painting, and crafting beautiful designs.
couple.welcome_message: જય શ્રી ગણેશ. We invite you to join us as we celebrate our love and begin this beautiful journey together.

events.description_en: Join us as we adorn Diya's hands with beautiful henna designs amidst music, dance, and joy.
events.description_gu: સંગીત અને આનંદ સાથે દિયાના હાથોમાં મહેંદીનો રંગ સજાવવાની સુંદર સાંજ.

events.description_en: Put on your traditional Kediya and Chaniya Choli for a magical night of Garba, Dandiya, and live Dhol beats!
events.description_gu: ખેલૈયાઓ તૈયાર થઈ જાઓ! ઢોલના ધબકારે ટ્રેડિશનલ ગરબા અને દાંડિયાની ધમાકેદાર સાંજ.

events.description_en: Auspicious prayers to begin the wedding rituals, followed by smearing the bride and groom with turmeric paste for a glowing start.
events.description_gu: શુભ મંડપ મુહૂર્ત પૂજન અને વર-કન્યાને હળદરની પીઠી ચોળવાની મંગલ વિધિ.

events.description_en: Witness the sacred vows, Hast Melap, and Mangal Fera as we tie our lives together forever.
events.description_gu: વૈદિક મંત્રોચ્ચાર વચ્ચે હસ્તમેળાપ અને પવિત્ર અગ્નિની સાક્ષીએ મંગલ ફેરાની દિવ્ય વિધિ.

events.description_en: Celebrate our new beginning with a grand dinner banquet. We look forward to your blessings.
events.description_gu: નવદંપતીને આશીર્વાદ આપવા સ્નેહ મિલન અને ભોજન સમારંભ.

love_story.title: The First Glimpse
love_story.description: We met in Ahmedabad during the Uttarayan kite festival. Under a sky full of colorful kites, our eyes met and a sweet conversation began.

love_story.title: The Proposal
love_story.description: Under the starry sky of the White Desert during the Rann Utsav, Aarav went down on one knee. Diya said YES, making it the most memorable night of our lives.

rsvps.name: Hiren Patel
rsvps.message: Congratulations to both! Looking forward to the wedding.

wishes.name: Nitin & Shruti Vyas
wishes.message: સદા સુખી ભવઃ! May your life be filled with endless laughter, love, and sweet memories.

wishes.name: Rajeshbhai & Family
wishes.message: ખૂબ ખૂબ અભિનંદન! Best wishes for this beautiful new chapter in your lives.
